IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'ATM_CARDACCOUNT' and table_schema = 'EDS' and table_type = 'BASE TABLE')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE EDS.ATM_CARDACCOUNT;
END;
IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'ATM_CARDACCOUNT' and table_schema = 'EDS' and table_type = 'VIEW')
BEGIN
   DROP VIEW EDS.ATM_CARDACCOUNT;
END;

CREATE TABLE EDS.ATM_CARDACCOUNT
WITH
(
	HEAP, DISTRIBUTION=HASH(CAT_CRD_ID)
)
AS
SELECT CAT_CRD_ID
	, CAT_ACN_ID
	, CAT_DEFAULT_FOR_TYPE
	, CAT_OVERALL_DEFAULT
	, CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS
	, FileName
	, TABLE_NAME
	, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) AS SCD_START_DATE
	, COALESCE(DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day, CAST('99991231' AS DATE)) AS SCD_END_DATE
	, ISACTIVE
	, CASE WHEN DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day is null then 1 else 0 end as ISLATEST
	, BNK_CODE
	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, insert_dttm

FROM
(
	SELECT CAT_CRD_ID
		, CAT_ACN_ID
		, CAT_DEFAULT_FOR_TYPE
		, CAT_OVERALL_DEFAULT
		, CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS
		, FileName
		, TABLE_NAME
		, isActive
		, isLatest
		, BNK_CODE
		, SOURCE_CODE
		, FILE_NAME
		, insert_dttm
		, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) START_DATE     
		, Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) Over (PARTITION BY CAT_CRD_ID
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) END_DATE                  				
	FROM
	(
		SELECT CAT_CRD_ID
			, CAT_ACN_ID
			, CAT_DEFAULT_FOR_TYPE
			, CAT_OVERALL_DEFAULT
			, CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS
			, FileName
			, TABLE_NAME
			, isActive
			, isLatest
			, BNK_CODE
			, SOURCE_CODE
			, FILE_NAME
			, insert_dttm
			, row_number() 
				over( partition by CAT_CRD_ID
						, CAT_ACN_ID
						, CAT_DEFAULT_FOR_TYPE
						, CAT_OVERALL_DEFAULT
						, CAT_LAST_UPDATE_TS
						, FileName
						, TABLE_NAME
						, isActive
						, isLatest
						, BNK_CODE
						, SOURCE_CODE
						, FILE_NAME
					order by insert_dttm DESC) AS SEQ_NO
		FROM BUSC.ATM_CARDACCOUNT

	) AS TMP
	WHERE SEQ_NO = 1
) AS SCDT2
LEFT JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM
	ON CAST(END_DATE AS INTEGER) = DATE_DIM.DATESK;

    	WHEN ISNUMERIC(CSH_STATUS_DATE) = 1 THEN CAST(STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(CSH_STATUS_DATE, 13, 0, ':'), 11, 0, ':'), 9, 0, ' ') AS DATETIME2)

	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, insert_dttm

(
	SELECT CSH_ID

						, CSH_EXPIRY_DATE
						, CSH_CARDHOLDER_NAME
						, CSH_CREATION_DATE
						, CSH_AUTO_RENEWAL
						, CSH_STS_ID
						, CSH_STATUS_DATE
						, CSH_CREATED_BY
						, CSH_CREATED_TS

						, CSH_UPDATED_TS

SELECT CCM_ID
	, CCM_CREATED_BY
	, CCM_AUDIT_LOG
	, CCM_CLT_ID
	, CCM_BAC_ID
	, CCM_CRD_ID
	, CCM_STS_ID
	, CCM_INS_ID
	, CCM_CREATED_TS
	, CCM_UPDATED_BY
	, CCM_UPDATED_TS
	, CCM_TYPE_DEFAULT
	, CCM_OVERALL_DEFAULT
	, CCM_UUID

	, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) AS SCD_START_DATE
	, COALESCE(DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day, CAST('99991231' AS DATE)) AS SCD_END_DATE
	, ISACTIVE
	, CASE WHEN DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day is null then 1 else 0 end as ISLATEST
	, BNK_CODE
	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, insert_dttm

FROM
(
	SELECT CCM_ID
		, CCM_CREATED_BY
		, CCM_AUDIT_LOG
		, CCM_CLT_ID
		, CCM_BAC_ID
		, CCM_CRD_ID
		, CCM_STS_ID
		, CCM_INS_ID
		, CCM_CREATED_TS
		, CCM_UPDATED_BY
		, CCM_UPDATED_TS
		, CCM_TYPE_DEFAULT
		, CCM_OVERALL_DEFAULT
		, CCM_UUID
		, isActive
		, isLatest
		, BNK_CODE
		, SOURCE_CODE
		, FILE_NAME
		, insert_dttm
	
		, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) START_DATE     
		, Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) Over (PARTITION BY CCM_ID
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) END_DATE                  				
	FROM
	(
		SELECT CCM_ID
			, CCM_CREATED_BY
			, CCM_AUDIT_LOG
			, CCM_CLT_ID
			, CCM_BAC_ID
			, CCM_CRD_ID
			, CCM_STS_ID
			, CCM_INS_ID
			, CCM_CREATED_TS
			, CCM_UPDATED_BY
			, CCM_UPDATED_TS
			, CCM_TYPE_DEFAULT
			, CCM_OVERALL_DEFAULT
			, CCM_UUID
			, isActive
			, isLatest
			, BNK_CODE
			, SOURCE_CODE
			, FILE_NAME
			, insert_dttm

			, row_number() 
				over( partition by CCM_ID
						, CCM_CREATED_BY
						, CCM_AUDIT_LOG
						, CCM_CLT_ID
						, CCM_BAC_ID
						, CCM_CRD_ID
						, CCM_STS_ID
						, CCM_INS_ID
						, CCM_CREATED_TS
						, CCM_UPDATED_BY
						, CCM_UPDATED_TS
						, CCM_TYPE_DEFAULT
						, CCM_OVERALL_DEFAULT
						, CCM_UUID
						, isActive
						, isLatest
						, BNK_CODE
						, SOURCE_CODE
						, FILE_NAME
						, insert_dttm
					order by insert_dttm DESC) AS SEQ_NO
		FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING

	) AS TMP
	WHERE SEQ_NO = 1
) AS SCDT2
LEFT JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM
	ON CAST(END_DATE AS INTEGER) = DATE_DIM.DATESK;
